methodologyNotes: Covers freshwater and inshore-saltwater fishing rods (spinning and baitcasting) sold at a published US MSRP or typical street price. Excludes fly rods, ice-fishing rods, surf rods over 10 ft, telescopic novelty rods, and rod-and-reel combos. Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD. configuration is the reel-mounting type (spinning or casting). lengthFt is the assembled rod length in feet as a decimal (7'0" = 7.0, 6'6" = 6.5). pieces is the number of blank sections (integer). power is the manufacturer power rating (ultralight, light, medium-light, medium, medium-heavy, heavy, extra-heavy). action is where the blank flexes under load (slow, moderate, moderate-fast, fast, extra-fast). lureWeightOz is the recommended lure/casting-weight range in ounces (as printed on the blank). lineWeightLb is the recommended line rating range in pound-test (monofilament). rodWeightOz is the physical rod weight in ounces; null if not disclosed. blankMaterial is the primary blank construction (graphite, carbon-fiber, fiberglass, or graphite-composite). guideMaterial is the guide insert/frame material (stainless-steel, aluminum-oxide, SiC, zirconia, or titanium). handleMaterial is the grip material (cork, EVA, or cork-EVA). Where a rod ships in many length/power variants, specs describe the most-reviewed flagship variant.
